scope: Theorem 9.6 (Local strong maximal estimate) of the manuscript “Endpoint convergence for the planar Schrodinger equation” (preprints/Endpoint-convergence-for-the-planar-Schrodinger-equation-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 080 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 68d6affc8c3cc3bc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 77-78. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a constant C such that, for every f ∈ H1/3(R2) whose Fourier transform has compact support and every x0 ∈ R2, Z B(x0,1) sup 0≤t<1 |S(t)f(x)| dx ≤ C∥f∥H1/3 . (9.16) 77 For arbitrary f ∈ H1/3(R2) there is a jointly measurable representative vf (x, t), 0 ≤ t < 1, continuous in t for almost every x, equal to S(t)f as an L2 function for each fixed t, and satisfying the same bound with S(t)f(x) replaced by vf (x, t).
